page: Microsoft Azure DC48as_v6 is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the DCasv6 family. It is powered by an AMD processor and runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance features 48 dedicated vCPUs and 192.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This server does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met using external volumes. It is Premium Storage capable, allowing integration with high-performance persistent disks. There are no complimentary public IPv4 addresses bundled with this instance.

Given its balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the instance represents a standard general-purpose hardware profile. It offers resource density suitable for multi-threaded applications, enterprise application servers, and medium-sized databases that utilize external storage. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing capabilities without resource contention.
